instruction: Cinematic over-the-shoulder medium shot in a hazy indoor boxing gym. Facing him in the midground on the left is the man in the black t-shirt (R2), who holds up red and white focus mitts in a defensive stance. The two men are positioned for a training session. The background is filled with gym equipment and a red wall mural under soft, misty lighting that creates a moody atmosphere.
